user.title: LG AC Infrared
user.description: Set up a Home Assistant climate entity that drives your LG split-AC through an ESPHome IR proxy. The proxy must expose at least an infrared transmitter entity; a receiver is optional but enables state synchronisation with the original remote.

data_description.transmitter_entity_id: The infrared.* transmitter on your ESPHome IR proxy device.
data_description.receiver_entity_id: Enables decoding of IR codes from the original remote so that HA can mirror manual changes.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Displayed as the current_temperature on the climate card.

error.transmitter_not_on_esphome: The selected transmitter is not provided by an ESPHome config entry.

abort.no_infrared_emitter: No infrared transmitter entities found. Flash an ESPHome ir_rf_proxy firmware first.
abort.already_configured: This IR proxy already has an LG AC entity configured.
